title: Say what the solver found before reading a plan
heading: Read the Status Before You Read a Value
cases: a proven optimum gives its status, its plan, its objective and proven = True
an infeasible model gives its status and no plan and no objective
a search stopped at its first plan still gives that plan, marked not proven
an invalid model gives no plan and the solver's own reason
a model with no objective gives a plan and no objective value
